_note: case-type-colour-icon (Ruben, 20 October 2026). A case type carries the colour and the icon the boards draw it in: its type pill on a case, its tag in a case list and its entry in the menu. The colour is a name from the same NL Design System hue list as statusType.colour, which gains teal for the boards' permit and subsidy tone, so a themed install repoints one token. The icon is a name from the app's registered icon set (src/icons.js), offered as a select that shows each icon. Both are optional: a case type without them draws as before. caseType moves to 1.26.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: The hue this case type is drawn in, on its type pill and its tag in case lists. A name from the NL Design System palette, as a status colour is. Leave it empty and the case type draws neutral.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: The icon this case type is drawn with, on its type pill and its entry in the menu. A name from the app's icon set. Leave it empty and the menu shows the filter icon.
